ios.desc:
Reverie transforms the story of your life into a beautiful soundtrack.

Some songs are forever linked to specific places. Think about that track that accompanied you on a late-night drive, the album that defined an unforgettable summer, or the song that played in the city where you fell head over heels. With Reverie, you can pin those songs to the exact locations where they resonated, creating a vibrant map of your cherished memories.

Just long-press anywhere on the map, search for a song, and drop a pin. Add your personal touch by including details like the mood, the year, the people who were there, and a note about that special moment. Over time, your map will come alive, turning into a personal atlas of all the places where music has touched your heart.

Pin songs to places
Explore the entire Apple Music catalog and link any song to a specific spot on your map.

Capture the whole moment
Label each memory with a mood, a year, the friends who shared it with you, and your own reflections.

Relive it in one tap
Tap on any pin to revisit the song, the location, and the emotions, then play it back in Apple Music or jump right to it on the map.

See your life take shape
Watch as your map fills up with album art, reflecting your growing collection of memories. You can browse, search, and filter everything by song, place, mood, or year.

Built for Apple Music
Quickly find any track and turn your memories into playlists that you can treasure.

Completely private, completely yours
Reverie is designed to be offline and local-only. Everything stays on your device—no accounts, no sign-ups, no cloud, and no tracking. Your memories are yours and yours alone.
